title: swift-institute repository metadata schema
description: Per-repo .github/metadata.yaml schema. Validates the declarative GitHub-side metadata that swift-institute's sync-metadata workflow propagates to each repo's GitHub settings. Topics are per-repo editorial choices: the schema validates SHAPE (kebab-case, length, count) but NOT vocabulary — each repo establishes its own topic set based on its content. The closed-enum constraint introduced in Wave 2b was retracted 2026-05-10 per principal direction; see Skills/github-repository/SKILL.md [GH-REPO-021].

description.description: Repo's GitHub description. Class-templated per Skills/github-repository [GH-REPO-011].

topics.description: GitHub-side topic tags propagated to the repo. Per-repo editorial — each repo establishes its own topic set based on its content. The schema validates SHAPE only (kebab-case, length, uniqueness, count cap); vocabulary is open. The `swift-` prefix is conventionally avoided on the org's own repos because it repeats the org name, but the schema does not enforce that.

items.description: Lowercase kebab-case, ≤ 50 chars per [GH-REPO-022]. No closed vocabulary.

homepage.description: Repo homepage URL. Class-templated per [GH-REPO-030]. Personal URLs are forbidden per [GH-REPO-031].

settings.description: GitHub repo settings overrides. Sync-metadata workflow propagates these via the GitHub API. Hub-repo override pattern documented at [GH-REPO-094].

defaultBranch.description: Default branch name (string), consumed by sync-metadata.yml as .settings.defaultBranch and documented by [GH-REPO-060]. NOT GitHub's GraphQL 'defaultBranchRef' object. Default 'main' per [GH-REPO-053].

allowMergeCommit.description: Allow merge commits. Default false per [GH-REPO-056] (squash-only).

allowSquashMerge.description: Allow squash merging. Default true per [GH-REPO-056] (squash-only).

allowRebaseMerge.description: Allow rebase merging. Default false per [GH-REPO-056] (squash-only).

deleteBranchOnMerge.description: Auto-delete head branch on merge. Default true per [GH-REPO-056].

secretScanning.description: GitHub secret scanning (public repos only; private needs GHAS). Default true per [GH-REPO-057].

secretScanningPushProtection.description: Secret-scanning push protection (public repos only). Default true per [GH-REPO-057].

secretScanningNonProviderPatterns.description: Scan for generic high-entropy secrets beyond known provider token formats (public repos only). Consumed by sync-metadata.yml as .settings.secretScanningNonProviderPatterns and PATCHed to security_and_analysis.secret_scanning_non_provider_patterns. Requires secretScanning; GitHub rejects the PATCH when secret scanning is disabled. Default true per [GH-REPO-057].

secretScanningValidityChecks.description: Test whether a discovered token is still live (public repos only). Consumed by sync-metadata.yml as .settings.secretScanningValidityChecks and PATCHed to security_and_analysis.secret_scanning_validity_checks. Requires secretScanning; GitHub rejects the PATCH when secret scanning is disabled. Default true per [GH-REPO-057].

sidebar.description: Repo 'About' sidebar section visibility per [GH-REPO-054]. Declared but NOT consumed by any workflow, deliberately: GitHub exposes no REST or GraphQL surface for these toggles, so enforcement is a manual gear-icon click and this block is the audit-able record of intended state until an API exists. It is declared here because [GH-REPO-054] and [GH-REPO-060] instruct maintainers to author it, and the top-level additionalProperties:false would otherwise fail a repo that follows that instruction. Do not read this as a live setting: adding a consumer is a change to [GH-REPO-054], not to this schema.

showReleases.description: Show the Releases section. Default true per [GH-REPO-054] — every Swift package publishes tagged releases.

showPackages.description: Show the Packages section. Default false per [GH-REPO-054] — Institute packages distribute via SwiftPM, not the GitHub Packages registry.

showDeployments.description: Show the Deployments section. Default false per [GH-REPO-054] — Institute packages run no GitHub Actions deployments.

discussion.description: Centralized discussion-thread URL per [GH-REPO-090..093]. A STRING, per [GH-REPO-091], which is canonical and names the accepted form https://github.com/orgs/swift-institute/discussions/{N}. This matches the only live consumer: sync-discussion-threads.yml reads the field as a scalar (yq -r '.discussion // ""') and writes it back as a quoted scalar (yq -i '.discussion = "$URL"'). Previously typed as an object with url/category/thread_id; no workflow or script ever read those sub-fields, and the object form rejected the very files this ecosystem's own workflow authors. Do not widen to accept both shapes — a scalar read of a mapping yields a serialized map that passes a non-empty test, so a dual-shape schema would license silent corruption rather than a loud failure.

socialPreview.description: Social-preview rendering parameters per Skills/social-preview [SOC-002 / SOC-003].

readme.description: README routing metadata. Per Wave 2b finalization Decision 7, the `family` field drives validate-readme.yml's per-family rule subset selection.

family.description: README family per Skills/readme/SKILL.md `## Family Routing`. A=user profile, C=process/workflow repo, E=sub-package (Tier 1+ implemented Swift package), F=placeholder/reservation, G=org profile (3 sub-tiers: top-level / org-of-orgs / leaf). The taxonomy has only 5 families — B and D are NOT defined. validate-readme.yml selects the per-family rule subset based on this field.
